tagline: Ultra‑marathoner mom who runs life at 7 mph
summary: When the spotlight fades, Randi is a relentless explorer of endurance—whether it’s a 100‑mile ultra or a new puzzle she tackles with childlike curiosity. She balances fierce competition with deep family love, often turning ordinary moments into epic adventures with her kids. Off the track she’s a savvy entrepreneur and speaker, constantly turning her marathon mindset into business and community impact.
